verdict.line: You win if you stun-burst Ornn with E (Facebreaker) and Q (Knuckle Down) before level 6; you lose if the lane drags past his R (Call of the Forge God) and Living Forge's bonus resistances.

brief.thesis: Sett's trading power comes from stacking E (Facebreaker)'s stun with Q (Knuckle Down)'s max-health punches, which is exactly why he holds both the lane and solo-kill advantage here. But Ornn's passive, Living Forge, grants him bonus Armor and Magic Resist from every item he buys, quietly blunting that physical burst the moment he completes his first component, and his R (Call of the Forge God) adds zone-wide Brittle and slows from level 6 onward that let him trade back. That's why the head-to-head sits at 47.3% over 1,614 games — below Sett's 50.6% baseline — the early window is real but closes faster than it does against a non-forging bruiser.

theirWindow.when: After he hits level 6 with R
theirWindow.what: Call of the Forge God's elemental runs through the lane applying Brittle and a slow, and Ornn can recast to redirect it into a full knockup. Give the elemental's path room and don't fight on top of the summon circle.

yourWindow.when: Right after Ornn burns Q, E or W
yourWindow.what: Volcanic Rupture (Q), Searing Charge (E) and Bellows Breath (W) are all sub-15s cooldowns early, so the moment he throws one, step in, land Facebreaker (E)'s stun, and dump Knuckle Down (Q)'s empowered punches before he has an escape or knockup ready.

powerCurve.note: E stun into Q burst wins trades
R elemental and Brittle swing fights

start.why: Run in 79.4% of games at 48.4% win rate — the extra auto damage and sustain let you win the short trades your E (Facebreaker) stun sets up without falling behind in poke.

boots.why: Taken in 49.1% of games at 49.3% win rate; the tenacity shortens how long Ornn's Brittle and knockup chains lock you down, and the Magic Resist offsets his Q/W/R magic damage.

core.why: First item in the top build path (57.2% win rate over 311 games); the slow-on-hit lets you stick through Ornn's Searing Charge (E) dashes instead of eating a shockwave at range.
Shreds the bonus Armor Living Forge stacks onto every one of Ornn's items, keeping Knuckle Down (Q)'s max-health punches and your autos from falling off.
Rounds out the top build path's health and damage, letting you tank Grit for W (Haymaker) without losing your own trading power.

situational.when: ornn's team has burst that threatens to kill you out of an all-in
ornn stacks pure armor and your flat damage starts bouncing off
you want your empowered Q punches and R slam to hit harder in extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage and healing rewards the point-blank trades Sett is forced into, since landing E (Facebreaker) and Q (Knuckle Down) means sitting inside Ornn's Searing Charge (E) and Bellows Breath (W) range.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 78.3% of these games at a 49% win rate, and it matches your measured solo-kill advantage — Ignite's burn secures the kill off an E (Facebreaker) stun before Ornn's sustain can bail him out.

playing.title: Punish his skill cooldowns
playing.detail: Bait Ornn into throwing Volcanic Rupture (Q), Searing Charge (E), or Bellows Breath (W) first, then cast Haymaker (W) once you've banked Grit from the poke — this is OP.GG's own read on the matchup.

playing.title: Stun off double-sided angles
playing.detail: Facebreaker (E) only stuns if Ornn is pulled in from both sides at once; catch him on one side only and you get a slow instead, so walk around or use terrain before you commit.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Your lane and solo-kill edge are front-loaded — land Q (Knuckle Down)'s empowered punches off an E stun while Ornn has no R, since Call of the Forge God isn't live until level 6.

playing.title: Give ground once his R is up
playing.detail: From level 6 on, the elemental runs through the lane applying Brittle and a slow, then Ornn can recast to redirect it into a knockup — don't stand in its path or fight on the summon point.

playing.title: Hold R for isolated picks
playing.detail: Save The Show Stopper (R) for moments Searing Charge (E) is on cooldown; a charge that hits terrain gives Ornn a knockup shockwave that can turn your slam back on you.

playing.title: Shred his bonus resistances
playing.detail: Living Forge stacks extra Armor and Magic Resist onto every item Ornn buys, so prioritize Black Cleaver's shred to keep your Q and autos relevant into the mid game.

playing.title: Avoid the final gout of W
playing.detail: Bellows Breath (W) only applies Brittle on the last tick of flame as Ornn advances through it — step out late rather than early, or you eat bonus damage on the follow-up.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, stun angles, Brittle timing — is my own read of the ability kits, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Try to gain the upper hand by using [W] when Ornn uses his abilities. Be careful of having your [R] absorbed when he is using (W).
